page0.text:
"What is that...?"
The first thing Saber sees after taking a detour in the temple grounds and reaching the lake is a massive lump of meat.

page1.text:
She is not like any other knight.
She fought many kinds of monsters when she was called a hero.
She has even fought dragonkin, famed to be the strongest of the Phantasmal species.
But even Saber can only falter at that lump of meat.
It is not because of how unsightly it is.
It is because she can tell that the curse released from that shape... That lump of meat... is the same as herself.

page2.text:
"A Servant... Can a Servant change that much if the summoning is done wrongly?"
Or is it the power of the Holy Grail?
She stares at the lump of meat, stunned, and shakes her head.

page3.text:
"Rin...! Where are you, Rin...!?"
She runs to the lake and yells to the lump of meat on the opposite shore.
She is hesitant to enter the black mud inside the lake.
It is not because it is unpleasant.
Her instincts tell her that she cannot touch it as a Servant who is a half-spirit.

page4.text:
"Guh!?"
She hears a voice calling.
It is faint, but she hears her Master's commands.
She looks closely and searches around the lump of meat...
"Rin...!?"
She steps forward without hesitation.

page5.text:
"...Hold on...! Stop, Saber, don't come in...!"
"Guh...!"
Saber's body stops.
She retreats and stares at the lump of meat while readying her sword.

page6.text:
"But Rin...!"
"Just don't...! You'll end up like this if you touch that mud. Stay there and get your Noble Phantasm ready. This clump will explode soon. Use your Noble Phantasm on it before that happens...!"
Saber cannot nod to her Master's tense voice.
...She can tell that the lump of meat is about to hatch.
The squirms turn into throbs, and the quantity of mud spat out continues increasing.

page7.text:
The lake turns black, and the black mud is overflowing onto the ground.
...That thing is growing.
The world's restraining power will be activated if that thing is left alone.
It is natural for her to destroy it with her sacred sword before that happens.
But to do that...
"Please escape, Rin! I can do it once you get out of the lake...!"

page8.text:
"...Yeah. Okay, I'll leave it to you. But go ahead and use it if I don't make it out on time.
...Our contract will get severed, but you should be fine if Shirou is alive, right?"
"Do not be ridiculous...! I do not care, I can handle a curse like this..."
Saber runs into the black mud, heading towards the lump of meat.
But her body does not move.
Her body stops just when she tries to go near the lake.

page9.text:
"Rin, did you use the Command Spell...?"
"...Of course. I can't let the only one who can destroy the Holy Grail die.
I told you there's no need to worry. I can easily get out of this. You can rest assured and stand by with your sacred sword."

page10.text:
The thoughts that she commands are full of composure as always.
"...Rin."
But, needless to say, it is just a bluff.
The lump of meat on the opposite shore.
Her Master that is there has nowhere to run.

page11.text:
"...Just kidding. Well, it's easier said than done."
She murmurs while being surrounded by strange arms made out of meat.
The situation is hopeless.
Shinji Matou was saved.
...She ripped off the blood vessels and nerves which had melted into his whole body and took him out of the lump of meat.
One could say he's alive, if one turns a blind eye to the after-effects he may have.
No, although he has fainted, one could say that he is better off than the girl carrying him.

page12.text:
"...The problem is after that. I guess it would go on a rampage if its heart got taken. Would it let me go if I give Shinji back?"
She slowly goes outside while staring at the tentacles blocking her way.
But there is no exit.
The tentacles are already blocking the way out to the lake.
Even if she were to escape the tentacles that are trying to wrap around her and swallow her whole, she wouldn't be able to break through the part that has become a wall.

page13.text:
"Ungh... My strength..."
She almost falls along with Shinji Matou and holds out with all her might.
Going past the cursed sea and crossing the floating island of meat, she even performed neurosurgery to separate Shinji Matou from the lump of meat.
At that point, the girl's magical energy had even broken into the reserve tank that she had not used for a long time...

page14.text:
"...Khh... Ugh, that idiot. Taking my magical energy without hesitation... Thanks to that, I'm all out..."
She bears the dizziness as she complains.
Of course she didn't mean it. She was just saying that.

page15.text:
Besides, things wouldn't change even if she had magical energy left.
The tentacles surrounding the girl have stopped because their prey is docile.
Once they figure out that the thing that has invaded their body is poisonous, they'll take immediate action.
Rin Tohsaka and Shinji Matou are alive because she does not have enough magical energy left for them to prey on.

page16.text:
"...Hrrk... But, I guess... this is it... It's getting hard... to even stay standing..."
Her vision grows hazy.
Although she is able to get a foothold, that does not change how she is still on mud.
Heat is encroaching on her nerves by the second.
If she falls onto the platform of meat, she herself will become the core of the Holy Grail this time.

page17.text:
Before that...
"...Sorry, Saber. I'm sure you won't listen to me, so I'll make you obey."
There is one Command Spell left.
That is enough to make Saber standing by on the opposite shore use her sacred sword.

page18.text:
"Khh... Also, I have to apologize to you too.
I couldn't... save Shinji..."

page19.text: "Just run. I don't want to hear such whining."

page20.text:
"...Huh?"
Her body that's about to collapse stops.
That voice.
Are the thoughts coming to her mind, instead of her ears, those of the Servant that she had made a contract with?

page21.text:
"Hey..."
She has no time to be bewildered.
She knows his personality well.
He told her to run, so he must have done something that she wouldn't be able to escape from if she didn't run...!

page22.text:
"Hnng...!!!!!!"
She runs through.
The arrows that rain from the sky are like a downpour.
She smashes everything that gets in her way, whether it is a net, platform, or tentacles of meat...!

page23.text:
"Agh, khh...!"
She has no time to look back.
She runs through with all her might while carrying Shinji Matou.

page24.text:
"Guh...!"
She jumps into the lake.
The arrows have swept the way for her escape route.
In just a short time the black mud is repelled, and only dirty water leads to the shore.

page25.text:
"Haah, haah...!"
She runs across the lake while carrying Shinji Matou.
She runs to the shore soaking wet with latent energy that shocks even her.

page26.text:
"Please, Saber...!"
Her magical energy replies to the screaming voice.
There is no need to check.
The golden sword is raised, and with overwhelming firepower, mows down everything in its sight.
The mountain of meat is cut in half and collapses.
The black mud evaporates, and the band of light changes the lake itself into a flat wasteland.
